choices.text: Who's that Choso character you keep mentioning?
What anime did you like back home?
What games did you play back home?
How are you finding this place?
You told me about Choso before.

choso.speech: Choso? From Jujutsu Kaisen. He's my favourite. Obviously.

choices.text: I've not seen Jujutsu Kaisen. Who is he?
You talk about him like you're married.
I know Gojo. What do you think of him?

choso_explain.speech: He's from Jujutsu Kaisen, an anime I watched back home. I could explain, but I'd spoil half of it.

choices.text: What makes you like him so much?

spoiler_free.speech: He's complicated and he cares about his family. That's enough to start with.

choices.text: Shame we can't watch it here.
You can tell me a little more.

choso_why.speech: His story's good. And I just like him, alright? I don't need a full argument for it.

choices.text: You don't have to justify it.

choso_husband.speech: He is my husband. Next question.

choices.text: I wasn't trying to upset you.
I'm just saying what I think.
What else did you watch back home?
Tell me about the other JJK characters.

jjk_others.speech: Gojo's good. Megumi too. They're not Choso, though.

choices.text: What do you like about Megumi?
Wish I could see the show again.
Have you seen anything besides JJK?

megumi.speech: He's interesting. There's more going on with him than he lets on.

choices.text: That sounds like a good character.
No spoilers. I never finished it back home.

anime.speech: I used to watch SK8 the Infinity, Banana Fish, Blue Lock, Sasaki and Miyano. Depends what you're into.

choices.text: Who's your favourite in Blue Lock?

sk8.speech: Reki and Langa. I like both of them. The skating's good too.

choices.text: What do you like about them?

sk8_more.speech: They're different, but they work well together. That's kind of the point.

choices.text: Wish I could watch it now.

banana.speech: Ash is my favourite. Wasn't exactly a cheerful show.

choices.text: I'd rather know if it's a heavy story.

banana_more.speech: Yeah, it's heavy. I'm not spoiling it, though.

sasaki.speech: I like Sasaki. It was a nice change from shows where everything's a fight.

choices.text: Sometimes a quieter story is better.

blue_lock.speech: I liked Blue Lock. Never really picked a favourite character, though.

choices.text: Fair. I won't make you choose.

blue_more.speech: Football, competition, and everyone taking it way too seriously. It's entertaining.

choices.text: Sounds like I'd have liked that.

anime_good.speech: Yeah. I miss having stuff like that to watch.

anime_insult.speech: I didn't ask you to like it.

music.speech: I used to listen to EPIC: The Musical and Mamma Mia!. Loads of other stuff too. Still get those songs stuck in my head.

choices.text: Did you listen to music when you were annoyed?

epic.speech: Greek mythology, but done as a musical. I like the story and the songs.

choices.text: Are you interested in mythology in general?
Wish I could hear it here.

mamma.speech: Yeah. It's fun. Not everything needs a complicated explanation.

choices.text: What's your favourite kind of story?

music_mood.speech: Yeah. If I can't listen to anything, I just get songs stuck in my head. Better than dealing with people sometimes.

choices.text: I'll leave you to it when you need space.

games.speech: HADES, Fortnite, Roblox. Played loads of stuff back home.

choices.text: HADES? Is that the Greek mythology one?
Do you miss gaming with people?
What was Fortnite like for you?

hades.speech: Yeah. Loved that game. And I already liked Greek mythology before I played it.

fortnite.speech: It was fun with the right people. That's most of it.

game_friends.speech: Talking to people in games was easier sometimes. Didn't have to make it weird.

choices.text: Want to talk about something else?

myth.speech: Back home people kept talking about the same three Greek gods. There was way more to those stories.

choices.text: Could you recommend somewhere to start?

myth_underworld.speech: The old stories about Hades get misrepresented a lot. The game wasn't the mythology.

choices.text: Makes me wish I'd read more of those stories.
So the game isn't entirely accurate?

myth_begin.speech: Pick one story and go from there. Otherwise you'll never remember who's related to who.

foxes.speech: Foxes are good. And Lucifer from Hazbin Hotel was another favourite character of mine.

choices.text: Lucifer? What do you like about him?
You have quite a few interests.

fox_more.speech: Look at them. That should explain it.

lucifer.speech: He's a good character. Don't start ranking him against Choso.

interest_reply.speech: Yeah, well. I like what I like.

choices.text: What's it been like arriving here?
What other anime do you remember?

town.speech: Still getting used to it. At least I know I'm not the only one who ended up here.

choices.text: You came from another world too?
Do you miss anything from before?

arrival.speech: Yeah. Doesn't mean I knew you back there. I've never met you before.

town_life.speech: It's alright. Some days I just want people to leave me alone.

miss_home.speech: Music, games, shows. Stuff I can't exactly go back and watch. Cba making it a whole thing.

choices.text: Sure. We can leave it there.
Want to talk about something lighter?

apology.speech: Alright. Just don't keep doing it.

choso_reality.speech: I know he's fictional. Doesn't change that I like him.

lost_media.speech: Yeah. No way to watch it here, is there? I still remember the good bits, though.

choices.text: What other shows do you remember?
Do you miss the old world?
Did you have a favourite character?

music_memory.speech: I can remember most of it. Not the same as actually hearing it, but whatever.

choices.text: Do you miss listening to music?
Was the musical about Greek mythology?
